answer.reason: The verses show Habakkuk crying out to the LORD about violence and praying for mercy, which adds to the summary.

clauses.english: cried to the LORD against the violence and wrong he saw
clauses.quote: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear!

clauses.english: prayed that the LORD would revive his work and remember mercy in wrath
clauses.quote: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years

doubts: The dataset's events of his time as prophet beginning and ending rest on HAB 1:6, which speaks of the Chaldeans, not of Habakkuk, so they were not used.
